g.text: Unstructured feedback in → structured, evidence-backed product insight out
LLMs are used where they add the most: 3.6k teacher labels, ~290 theme names, insight text and the analyst.
Everything else runs on the distilled student (521 items/s on a T4) — only 1.7 % of items ever touch an LLM.
Every metric has a baseline and a regression floor
